<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/budget-planning">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BudgetPlanning" name="Department Budget Planning and Allocation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Objectives" name="Begin budget planning"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OutlineObjectives" name="Outline department objectives"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftPlan" name="Draft plan with cost estimates and justifications"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StrategicReview" name="Review plan in strategic alignment meeting"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinanceReview" name="Review budget feasibility (Finance)"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Adjustments" name="Are adjustments required?" default="Flow_FinalApproval"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DocumentAdjustment" name="Document adjustment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveAdjustment" name="Approve adjustment (necessary stakeholders)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" name="Approve final budget"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateBudget" name="Allocate budget to department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeBudget" name="Distribute budget"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BeginImplementation" name="Begin implementing plan"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ImplementationBegun" name="Budget distributed and implementation begun"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Outline" sourceRef="StartEvent_Objectives" targetRef="Task_OutlineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outline_Draft" sourceRef="Task_OutlineObjectives" targetRef="Task_DraftPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Draft_Strategic" sourceRef="Task_DraftPlan" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Strategic_Finance" sourceRef="Task_StrategicReview" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Finance_Adjustments" sourceRef="Task_FinanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustmentRequired" name="Adjustments required" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustments" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Review feedback requires adjustments</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalApproval" name="No further adjustments" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustments" targetRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Document_ApproveAdjustment" sourceRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment" targetRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApproveAdjustment_Strategic" sourceRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approve_Allocate" sourceRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" targetRef="Task_AllocateBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_Distribute" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="Task_DistributeBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Distribute_Implement" sourceRef="Task_DistributeBudget" targetRef="Task_BeginImplementation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Implement_End" sourceRef="Task_BeginImplementation" targetRef="EndEvent_ImplementationBegun"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that reviews may recur and that feedback from those reviews can lead to changes: Model feedback and change work as explicit activities, and use a decision gateway with a loop to a review when another review may be needed.
rules.situation: the description states that reviews may recur and that feedback from those reviews can lead to changes

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity together with a purpose, object, or scope that distinguishes what is being done: Label the corresponding BPMN task with its core action and enough of those stated details to preserve the activity’s meaning; do not add unsupported details or omit details that distinguish it.
rules.situation: the description states an activity or a process start or end with a specific action, object, or outcome

rules.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules.situation: the description states the action, object, purpose, or outcome of an activity or process event
